topics.description: Minnesota officials are pushing for law changes to prevent fraud in Medicaid programs. The state has spent $20 billion on Medicaid programs at high risk for fraud since 2018.
topics.reason: New developments in fraud prevention and investigation

topics.description: Federal investigators are looking into HVAC unit fires in schools across the U.S. The investigation aims to determine the cause of the fires and prevent future incidents.
topics.reason: Ongoing investigation into HVAC unit fires
